tools.name: find_gyms
tools.description: Find BJJ gyms near a US city, neighborhood, or ZIP. Defaults: open to drop-ins, classes today. Returns drop-in policy, visitor fee when known, matching class times, and online booking (reservePrice, reserveUrl) when the gym takes reservations.

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Full public gym card: address, drop-in policy, visitor fee, the weekly timetable, and online booking when the gym takes reservations (price and reserveUrl per class). Use an id or slug from find_gyms.

tools.name: start_reservation
tools.description: Check that a class at a gym can be reserved online right now and get the link where the visitor signs the gym's waiver and pays (or reserves free). Returns the class's next date and start time, price, cancellation policy, and reserveUrl. It does not book anything: the visitor must open reserveUrl an

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: US cities OpenMapp covers, with gym counts, how many welcome class drop-ins, and how many list an open mat. Use this to check coverage before find_gyms. Filter by city name or two-letter state.

tools.name: map_url
tools.description: OpenMapp map link for a city search, optionally with a gym drawer already open.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_gyms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
